steps: Peel and dice 1 Mango; place pieces in a blender and blend until smooth.
Halve and pit 2 Avocados; scoop flesh into a medium bowl and mash with a fork.
Pour the mango purée over the mashed avocado and stir to combine.
Add 60 ml Coconut milk and 10 ml Lime juice; stir until creamy.
Sprinkle in 20 g Chia seeds and stir well.
Let the mixture stand for 8 minutes, stirring once, until slightly thickened.
Spoon evenly into 4 small cups. Refrigerate in airtight containers for up to 1 day; stir before serving.
